verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents extending a video clip or regenerating a single segment of a video. The closest items are adjacent: mask-based local re-editing applies to Image 3.0 Omni, not video; 'video input' pricing and multi-shot storyboarding are different capabilities; and the generic claim about refining videos in post-production does not establish segment-level regeneration or clip extension.

support.subject: As a creator, I can extend a clip or regenerate one segment of it without re-rendering the whole video
